messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for deployment/inference-api image=inference-api:v2 -> 10% traffic. Health check failures: 2/5 pods CrashLoopBackOff. alert: canary.health.failure count=7 :rotating_light:

riley-oncall: taking this, paging oncall. checking pods now.

jamie-sre: saw the CrashLoopBackOff. grab logs: `kubectl -n prod logs inference-api-canary-7f9c8 -c inference`

alex-eng: logs show init container `init-permissions` failing repeatedly with `chown: changing ownership of '/models': Permission denied`. the new manifest added an init container to chown /models as non-root. looks like image runs as non-root so chown fails -> container exits 1.

riley-oncall: confirmed. init container crash means readiness never true. this will keep the pod in CrashLoopBackOff and cause kube to evict/replace, HPA will react. impact?

carla-cs: we're seeing ~5% error increase for inference calls in EU region, a few customers reported timeouts. filing incident ticket INC-4621 and messaging affected customers.

jamie-sre: mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout (stop new canary pods) 2) flip feature flag for v2 model `ff/model-v2` to off as emergency kill-switch 3) rollback deployment to revision prior to v2.

riley-oncall: pausing rollout -> scaling down canary replicaset to 0: `kubectl -n prod scale rs inference-api-canary-7f9c8 --replicas=0` (done)

deploy-bot: Received command: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=42` -> rollback started.

alex-eng: also setting HPA minReplicas=2 temporarily to avoid zero-capacity oscillations: `kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference-api -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'`

jamie-sre: feature flag flipped (`ff/model-v2=off`) and rollback completed, old pods are back and readiness passed. monitoring metrics.

carla-cs: customer impact note updated: error-rate returned to baseline after rollback, will send follow-up to affected customers in 1h once stable.

riley-oncall: closing incident channel once stable. follow-ups: revert init container change in PR, add pre-deploy smoke that runs init container as non-root to catch permission denial, add e2e for model dir perms, and document emergency rollback runbook. :white_check_mark:

jamie-sre: adding post-mortem owner and ETA to ticket. thanks team.
